character_facts: The two combatants are capable of surviving and moving through multiple extreme cosmic dimensions.
Their conflict is intense enough to damage or contaminate otherwise transcendent realms.
At least one combatant may have an organic or biomechanical monstrous aspect, based on the inset face.
characters_present: Two unnamed combatants represented primarily as luminous streaks or small attacking craft.
A snarling organic or biomechanical face shown in inset, likely connected to one of the combatants.
continuity_links: This spread continues an already ongoing fight; the narration describes the combatants as repeatedly accelerating and penetrating new layers of space.
The page functions as a transition from a prior battle in normal space into increasingly primordial cosmological domains.
dialogue_meaning: The narration explains that the duel escalates beyond ordinary space into foundational cosmic realms.
It emphasizes that inter-space is mythic and fundamental to the universe's structure.
The fighters must briefly act in tandem or at least cease attacking to traverse one hostile dimension.
Their violence is contrasted against the beauty and calm of the dimension of origins, which they defile with battle.
locations: Inter-space, described as the essential fabric of the universe.
A geometric dimension of endless straight lines and implacable angles.
The chaotic amber zone beneath those angular structures.
The 'dimension of origins,' populated by living lights.
lore_facts: 'Inter-space' is presented as a mythical 'past-beyond' and the essential fabric of the universe.
Explosive anti-matter-disrupting or disintegrator-like attacks can open breaches into inter-space.
One region of inter-space is depicted as an infinity of straight lines composed of further straight-line clusters.
Traversal of that region requires the entrants to become filament-like.
Below the angular structures lies a 'chaotic amber zone' where new labyrinths are constantly born and swept by colossal hurricanes.
There exists a 'dimension of origins' within or beyond inter-space.
The dimension of origins contains only living lights, compared to gemlike galaxy-scale entities.
The dimension of origins is characterized as purely beautiful and eternally calm.
plot_events: Two opponents continue fighting with powerful energy-based attacks.
Their weapons or impacts rupture normal space and open a breach into inter-space.
They are swallowed into a vast abstract region described as filled with endless straight-line structures.
To pass through this realm, they stop fighting momentarily and become filament-like streaks.
They descend past a chaotic amber zone beneath rigid angular formations.
Still accelerating, they penetrate deeper into inter-space and enter the 'dimension of origins.'
In that serene realm of living lights, they resume or continue their destructive exchange of beams.
uncertainties: Some narration is small and partially difficult to read; wording may be approximate in places.
The exact identities of the two combatants are not given on this page.
It is unclear whether the inset monstrous face is literally one fighter, a transformation, or a symbolic visual.
The exact spelling of the attack term near the top left is hard to confirm from the image alone.
visual_summary: A painted double-page spread follows two combatants as bright energy streaks racing through abstract cosmic realms. Their battle fire tears open a passage into inter-space, then carries them through geometric and luminous dimensions. Insets show a red crystalline passage, a close-up of a snarling organic or biomechanical face, vast angular golden structures, and small craft exchanging fire amid blazing orbs.
